Predicates:
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
Last(x, y) ::: x is the last occurrence of y.
InLocation(x, y) ::: x was held in location y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in event y.
UnitedStates ::: the United States.
Tokyo ::: Tokyo.
Premises:
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
Last(x, y) ::: x is the last summer Olympic games.
InLocation(x, Tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, x) ::: The United States won the most medals in x.
Conclusion:
WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, x) ::: The United States won the most medals in the last summer Olympic games.
